{{Quote|The micro-grenade launcher is a devastating weapon, but make sure that you replace the magnetic rings that propel the explosive. During a firefight on Maro Della, the rings&mdash;which had degraded after repeated use&mdash;failed and jammed a grenade in the barrel. I only had a couple of seconds to toss the gun before the grenade detonated.|Hyannis, ''Gundark's Gear Datalog''|<ref name="Gundark" />}}
'''Maro Della''' was a terrestrial astronomical object<ref name="Gundark" /> located in the [[Maro Della system/Legends|Maro Della system]] of the [[Mektrun sector/Legends|Mektrun sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> At some point by the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] [[3 ABY/Legends|38:4:1:02]], the individual [[Hyannis]] was involved in a [[Firefight on Maro Della|firefight]] on Maro Della. During the skirmish, Hyannis prepared to fire a [[Model MGL-1]] [[Micro-grenade launcher/Legends|micro-grenade launcher]]. The [[Magnet/Legends|magnetic]] rings that propelled the [[Grenade launcher/Legends|weapon's]] [[Micro-grenade/Legends|projectiles]], however, had degraded due to lack of maintenance and failed. As a result, a micro-[[Grenade/Legends|grenade]] was jammed in the weapon's [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]], and Hyannis had to throw the launcher away before the grenade detonated within [[Standard second|seconds]]. Hyannis later mentioned the incident on Maro Della in the illegal database ''[[Gundark's Gear Datalog]]''.<ref name="Gundark" />

==Behind the scenes==
Maro Della was mentioned in the [[1997]] sourcebook ''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]'', which was published for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Gundark" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Maro Della [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body, in grid square L-17.<ref name="TEA" />
